info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Falcon Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Falcon Recliner Details API enables clients to seamlessly add detailed specifications for the Falcon Recliner into the product catalog. This functionality is essential for retailers and manufacturers looking to maintain up-to-date information on their product offerings. Businesses can utilize this API to enhance the visibility of the recliner's features, allowing consumers to make informed purchasing decisions. Ideal users include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and marketing teams focused on furniture products.

post.summary: Create recliner details for Falcon model.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information about the Falcon recliner model, including specifications, features, and customer preferences. Use this to enhance the product's visibility and user information.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details for the Falcon recliner. It contains all necessary fields required to specify the desired attributes and characteristics of the recliner.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogFalconReclinerDetailRequest.title: Falcon Recliner Operation Request

falcon_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Falcon recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Falcon recliners to operate on.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Falcon recliner.

CreateCatalogFalconReclinerDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for operations involving Falcon recliners.

CreateCatalogFalconReclinerDetailRespons.title: Falcon Recliner Details Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the processed record.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed, formatted as an ISO 8601 date.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogFalconReclinerDetailRespons.description: Response schema for successful operations on Falcon Recliner details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response. The header value typically indicates the content type of the response, such as application/json or text/html.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in assessing the performance of the API.
